common.noRealMoney: No real money. Chips have no value and can't be withdrawn.

play.title: PokerALL
play.subtitle: Learn the game, drill your decisions, climb the ranked ladder.

bots.title: Practice vs bots
bots.body: Heads-up and 6-max against bots with three playing styles. Works offline.

ranked.title: Ranked
ranked.body: Heads-up and 6-max Sit & Go. Everyone starts with the same stack, only rating is at stake.

casual.title: Casual tables
casual.body: Play other people for free practice chips.

academy.title: Academy
academy.subtitle: Short lessons with interactive charts and a quiz at the end.

basics.title: Basics
basics.body: Hand rankings, rules, streets, blinds and antes.

positions.title: Positions
positions.body: Every seat at 6-max and 9-max tables, and why acting last wins more.

ranges.title: Ranges
ranges.body: The 13×13 grid, opening ranges for each position, combos and blockers.

sizing.title: Bet sizing
sizing.body: Preflop opens and 3-bets, c-bet sizes for dry and wet boards.

math.title: Poker math
math.body: Outs, pot odds, equity, EV and minimum defense frequency.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.body: Board texture, bluffing, ICM and adjusting to opponents.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.body: Every poker term explained in English and Russian.

train.title: Train
train.subtitle: Fast drills with instant feedback. Mistakes come back until you fix them.

preflop.title: Preflop trainer
preflop.body: Get a hand and a position, choose fold, call or raise, see the correct play.

potOdds.title: Pot odds quiz
potOdds.body: Decide whether a call is profitable before the timer runs out.

daily.title: Daily challenge
daily.body: Ten new spots every day and a leaderboard for the best score.

profile.title: Profile
profile.guestHint: Progress is saved on this phone. Accounts arrive with online play.
